newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Dock & Canal Trust receives $25/shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Dock & Canal Trust receives $25/shr offer.

text.p: Chicago Dock & Canal Trust said it received a proposal from CityFront Center L.L.C. to acquire all of the trust's shares for $25 each.

In a prepared statement released Saturday, Chicago Dock & Canal Trust said the revised offer was deemed a "superior proposal" to a $23-per-share offer received from Newsweb Corp December 20. Newsweb originally offered $21 per share for the company in September but raised its bid on Friday.
Chicago Dock & Canal Trust said the CityFront proposal is subject to resolution of litigation filed by Newsweb against the trust, CityFront and other related parties.
Chicago Dock & Canal Trust is a real estate investment trust. Its stock was up 1-14/16 Monday at 24-7/16.
